admissions.reason: IgG4-related disease is a systemic fibroinflammatory condition, distinct from infectious or localized inflammatory processes.
Tolosa-Hunt syndrome is an idiopathic granulomatous inflammation of the cavernous sinus or superior orbital fissure, distinct from infectious sinusitis or systemic IgG4-related disease.
Streptococcal sinusitis is a bacterial infection of the sinuses, distinct from fungal infections, idiopathic inflammatory conditions, or systemic autoimmune diseases.
Invasive fungal sinusitis is a severe fungal infection of the sinuses, distinct from bacterial infections, idiopathic inflammatory conditions, or systemic autoimmune diseases.
